_about: Future roles the app can recommend. esco_title must match an ESCO occupation's preferred label exactly; ingest/build_seed.py looks it up and stores its URI, ISCO-08 code, ESCO skills and the ILO 2025 exposure score. req is the team's curated requirement (cluster id -> level 1 basic, 2 working, 3 strong), reviewed against the ESCO skills shown in the app. sdg links name a UN SDG target and say why it applies.
